_comment: Pinned floor of known source files. The folder scrape may ADD ids to the archive's known set, but a scrape can never REMOVE these. Every id here is fetched directly by id each run, even if the folder listing stops mentioning it. This is what keeps a broken scrape from looking like 'the university deleted everything'.

_reused_ids.14LFgZwIAeQLjWSJBDkk2QNf1UI9vA0dsCB3ITSV: Held 'July 2026 Daily Crime Log' until 2026-11-01. On 2026-11-02 Rowan renamed this file to November 2026, deleted July's 23 rows and rewrote the banner row, reusing the container rather than publishing a new file. July's rows are preserved in the archive as source_removed. Row-level month comes from each sheet's own banner via parse.source_month(), not from this name, so rows archived before and after the reuse each carry the right month.
